name: create-cytoscape-app
description: Scaffold a Cytoscape Web app: npm create cytoscape-app my-app
//repository: REQUIRED for provenance, not decoration. npm validates that this
matches the repository the sigstore bundle attests to; an absent or
mismatched url fails the publish with a 422 — and `npm publish
--dry-run` cannot catch it, because a dry run never contacts the
registry and so never runs that validation.
//scripts: sync-templates copies the template sources OUT of the working example apps
before the package is built or published, so a template cannot drift from
an app that is actually built, verified and loaded in a host on every CI
run. prepack runs it again because `npm pack` does not run `build`.
